source_text: Prospective studies, including those tracking sexual function in over 1,000 women across Mali and Sierra Leone, find no improvement in obstetric outcomes—infant mortality remains comparable or higher due to infibulation complications—and report diminished clitoral sensation in 70-80% of cases, challenging moderation claims without substantiating fidelity effects. [96]
